demo.note: Opportunity cost is a man at the door with two keys. Use it in the talk.

transcript.title: Walking as thinking
turns: Why do so many writers say the sentence only came together once they stood up from the desk?
At a desk your eyes stay fixed on the page, and the argument narrows to whatever is already in front of you.
And ten minutes into a walk, the knot comes undone on its own.
Your pace gives the thought a rhythm, without asking you to finish it yet.
